title: Mbodi AI Recruitment Drive Targets Research Engineers to Build Next Generation Robotics
ai_summary: Mbodi AI, a robotics startup focused on embodied AI, is expanding its hiring to recruit research engineers who will help develop AI systems enabling robots to interpret commands, sense environments, and perform physical tasks. The company has not yet posted specific job openings, qualifications, or pay details, but candidates are expected to have expertise in machine learning, deep learning frameworks, reinforcement learning, and robotics. The hiring spree suggests Mbodi AI is preparing for larger experiments, new product development, or commercial partnerships in sectors such as manufacturing, logistics, and home assistance.
